blocks.text: 1964 mein M. Gell-Mann aur George Zweig ne propose kiya (tajweez di) ke koi bhi hadron, proton aur neutron bhi, sach mein fundamental nahi, balke teen aur zyada fundamental cheezon ke combination (mel) se bana hai jinhein quarks ya quark flavours kehte hain. Quarks leptons ki tarah sach mein fundamental particles mane jate hain. Shuru ke teen quarks ke naam up, down aur strange the (symbols u, d, s). Aaj hum chhe quarks jante hain, jaise chhe leptons hain; nature mein ek maani hui symmetry (barabari) ki base par. Baqi teen charm, bottom aur top (c, b, t) hain (Table 12.4). Har quark ka spin aur electric charge hai, aur yeh charge electron ke charge e ka ek hissa (fraction, jaise 2/3 ya 1/3) hai, jise pehle sab se chhota charge samjha jata tha. Quarks nazar nahi aate; yeh kabhi akele nahi milte.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Table 12.4 mein anti-up quark ko 'm̄' likhti hai; yeh printing ki ghalti hai. Sahi symbol ū (anti-up) hai, charge −2/3.

Tamam hadrons quarks ke combination se bane hain (aur gluons unhein jor kar rakhte hain), aur un ki properties (khoobiyan) un ke quarks dekh kar samjhi jati hain. Mesons ek quark aur ek antiquark ka pair (jora) hain. Maslan π⁺ meson u aur d̄ (up aur anti-down) se bana hai, aur π⁰ u aur ū se ban sakta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab π⁺ ko 'ud combination' likhti hai. Sahi ud̄ hai (up quark + anti-down quark): charge +2/3 + 1/3 = +1. Kitab khud aage yahi likhti hai. u aur d ka charge to +2/3 − 1/3 = +1/3 hota.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab proton ki composition 'ud' aur us ke jor ko 'q(udd)' likhti hai. Proton mein teen quarks hain: uud. Jor 2/3 + 2/3 − 1/3 = +1 bhi uud ka hi hai; udd to neutron hai.
Neutron ki quark composition udd hai (ek up, do down), aur charge quantum number:

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har quark ka charge jor kar dekhein: up quark (u) +2/3 aur down quark (d) −1/3. Proton = u + u + d = 2/3 + 2/3 − 1/3 = +1. Neutron = u + d + d = 2/3 − 1/3 − 1/3 = 0. Kitab ki tasveer mein quarks ke letters bohat chhote chhape hain, is liye yahan text ke mutabiq proton mein u, u, d aur neutron mein u, d, d likhe gaye hain.

Mesons quark-antiquark pairs hain. π⁺ meson lein: is mein up quark u aur antidown quark d̄ hai. Up quark ka charge +2/3 aur antidown ka +1/3 hai (down ke −1/3 ka ulta). Jor +1 banta hai: q = 2/3 + 1/3 = +1, jo π⁺ ka charge hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab “q(u) = 2/3 + 1/3 = +1” likhti hai. π⁺ ke dono quarks ka charge jorna hai: q(ud̄) = 2/3 + 1/3 = +1; akele u ka charge +2/3 hai.

Quark theory ke kuch hi baad kaha gaya ke quarks ki ek aur property (khoobi) hai jisay colour ya “colour charge” kehte hain (electric charge jaisi). Is theory ke mutabiq har flavour ka quark teen colours mein se ek rakh sakta hai: red, green ya blue. Yaad rahe “colour” aur “flavour” ka hamare senses (dekhne, chakhne) se koi talluq nahi; yeh sirf mazaaq ke taur par rakhe gaye naam hain, jaise charm. Antiquarks ke colours antired, antigreen aur antiblue hain. Baryon teen quarks se bana hai, har colour ka ek. Meson ek colour aur us ke anticolour wale quark-antiquark ka pair hai. Is tarah baryons aur mesons dono colourless (be-rang), yani 'white', hain. Har quark par colour charge hai, aur quarks ke darmiyan strong force ko colour force kehte hain. Strong force ki is theory ko quantum chromodynamics (QCD) kehte hain, kyunke yeh force colour charges ke darmiyan lagti hai (electric charges ke darmiyan nahi). Do hadrons ke darmiyan strong force asal mein un ke quarks ke darmiyan ki force hai.

blocks.alt: Teen bare circles (daire). (a) Proton aur Neutron: har ek mein teen quarks, ek blue, ek red aur ek green; proton mein u, d aur u, neutron mein u, d aur d. (b) Antiproton: teen antiquarks, anti-u yellow (antiblue), anti-u magenta (antigreen) aur anti-d cyan (antired).
blocks.caption: Figure 12.7: (a) Colourless (be-rang) baryons: blue + red + green = white; (b) Colourless antibaryon: antiblue + antired + antigreen = white (kitab ki Figure 12.7 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har baryon mein teen quarks hain aur har quark ka 'colour' alag hai: ek red, ek green, ek blue. Teeno mil kar 'white' yani colourless (be-rang) ho jate hain, jaise roshni ke teen basic rang mil kar white (safed) roshni banate hain. Antiproton ke antiquarks ulte rang (anticolours) rakhte hain: antiblue ko yellow (peela), antigreen ko magenta aur antired ko cyan dikhaya gaya hai; yeh teeno bhi mil kar white hain. Yaad rahe ke yeh 'colour' asal rang nahi, sirf quarks ki ek property (colour charge) ka naam hai.
